info.title: SnackShop API
info.description: Backend for the SnackShop storefront and admin. Errors follow RFC 9457 problem details.

post.summary: Create a product with its first variant and initial stock.
Upload a JPEG/PNG/WebP image (max 5 MB) as multipart/form-data.
Confirm a pending order (commits stock; bank transfers must be paid).
Mark a confirmed order as being prepared.
Hand the order to the shipper.
Mark the order delivered (COD becomes paid).
Cancel the order with a reason (stock released or returned).
Record that payment was received.
Confirm the money of a cancelled paid order was returned.
Create an employee account (Staff, optionally Admin).
Lock or unlock an account.

get.summary: Full shop settings for the admin settings page.

post.summary: Create a customer account and sign in.
Sign in with email and password.
Sign in or sign up with a Google ID token.
Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair (rotation).
Revoke a refresh token.
Email a password reset link (always 204).
Set a new password from the emailed token; signs out all sessions.
Confirm the email address from the emailed link.

get.summary: Active categories for the storefront menu.
Product listing with category filter, accent-insensitive search, sort and paging.
Product page: details, images, variants with available stock.

put.summary: Change password; signs out every session.

post.summary: Merge the guest (browser) cart after sign-in.
Cancel my order while it is still pending.
Price a prospective order with live prices, stock and shipping fee.
Place an order (COD or bank transfer). Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

get.summary: Guest order tracking by order number and delivery phone.
Shop contact, shipping policy and bank account shown on the storefront.

AddCartItemCommand.description: Adds a quantity of a variant to the cart (summed with what is already there).

AddressRequest.description: Wire input for a postal address (checkout and address book).

AddressResponse.description: Wire representation of a postal address.

AdminCategoryResponse.description: Admin view of a category, including hidden ones.

AdminOrderActionsResponse.description: Allowed next actions, so the admin UI never re-implements the state machine.

AuthResponse.description: Result of every sign-in flow: a short-lived access token and a rotating refresh token.

BankTransferInstructionsResponse.description: How to pay a bank-transfer order. string BankTransferInstructionsResponse.QrImageUrl is a VietQR image with amount and content prefilled.

CartLineRequest.description: Input line used by guest cart merge, estimate and checkout.

CategoryResponse.description: Storefront category with the number of visible products.

ChangePasswordCommand.description:
Changes (or, for Google-only accounts, sets) the password and signs out every session.
string? ChangePasswordCommand.CurrentPassword is ignored when the account has no password yet.

CreateCategoryCommand.description: Creates a category. When string? CreateCategoryCommand.Slug is empty it is generated from the name.

CreateProductCommand.description: Creates a product with its first variant and that variant's stock record (with optional initial stock).

CreateStaffCommand.description: Creates an employee account with a temporary password. bool CreateStaffCommand.IsAdmin also grants the Admin role.

CustomerSummaryResponse.description: Admin customer list row. Spend counts delivered orders only.

DashboardResponse.description: Admin home page. Revenue counts delivered orders by delivery date (Vietnam calendar days).

EstimateOrderQuery.description: Prices a prospective order (checkout page): live prices, stock, shipping fee and total.

ForgotPasswordCommand.description: Emails a reset link when the account exists. Always succeeds so emails cannot be enumerated.

LoginWithGoogleCommand.description: Signs in (or signs up) a customer with a Google ID token from Google Identity Services.

MergeCartCommand.description: Merges a guest (browser) cart into the server cart after sign-in. Unavailable variants are skipped.

MoneyRequest.description: Wire input for Money. Validators check range; handlers convert with Money MoneyRequest.ToMoney().

OrderDetailResponse.description: Customer-facing order view (my orders, guest tracking).

OrderStatus.description: Order lifecycle. Transitions are enforced by Order (docs/03 §5).

PagedResponseOfAdminOrderSummaryResponse.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PagedResponseOfAdminProductSummaryRespon.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PagedResponseOfAdminUserResponse.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PagedResponseOfCustomerSummaryResponse.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PagedResponseOfOrderSummaryResponse.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PagedResponseOfProductSummaryResponse.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PagedResponseOfStockLevelResponse.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PagedResponseOfStockMovementResponse.description: Standard page envelope for every list endpoint (docs/05 §5).

PlaceOrderRequest.description: Checkout body. The idempotency key travels only in the Idempotency-Key header.

PricedLineResponse.description: A cart or estimate line priced from live catalog data.

ProductSummaryResponse.description: Product card on listing pages. Price is the cheapest active variant.

ProductVariantResponse.description: Storefront variant. int ProductVariantResponse.AvailableQuantity is what can be ordered right now.

RegisterCommand.description: Creates a customer account (and its shopping profile) and signs it in.

ResetPasswordCommand.description: Sets a new password from an emailed token and signs out every session of the account.

RevenuePointResponse.description: Revenue of one Vietnam calendar day.

VariantRequest.description: Wire input for a variant. Empty string? VariantRequest.Name means the default (unnamed) variant.

Bearer.description: Paste the access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login.
